entities.summary: Hephthalite, a notable figure in the history of Afghanistan, associated with Hephthalite and Turk Shahi Period (400–565). Preceded by Hephthalite (White Hun) Domination. Their legacy influenced Hephthalites under Mihirakula devastate Buddhist monasteries across Gandhara and Turk Shahi and Hindu Shahi Kabul.
